thread:
alex: Heads-up — canary hybrid-node gpu-smoke (job #2045) turned red during warmup on an H100. Logs show allocation failures + a driver version mismatch. Anyone else seeing provisioning drift? :thinking:

ci-bot: job: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/2045 logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/2045/logs — error snippets: `CUDA error: out of memory` then `cudaDriverVersion: 535.54` in container vs `node_driver: 535.86` reported by node agent.

meenal: ugh, we've seen node images get out of sync after the infra deploy last night. clicking into logs now.

alex: can we just rerun pinned to runtime image 535.86 to check if it's provisioning drift vs commit regression?

sam: +1 rerun. If it stays red we should bisect commits between last-green and this run. low flakiness window currently.

infra-robin: I can repro-provision a test node. quick checklist: 1) repro with `kubectl debug` into the canary node 2) verify `nvidia-smi` output and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` 3) compare container runtime libcuda symbols. Will do a repro and kick a rerun pinned to image `gpu-runtime:535.86` — giving ETA ~10m.

tara: pinging @eng-sre to check if the node pool auto-upgrade ran last night (could explain mixed drivers).

ci-bot: rerun triggered by infra-robin: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/2045/rerun/1 (image=gpu-runtime:535.86)

infra-robin: quick repro notes pasted:
```
# ssh into repro node
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,name --format=csv
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
# inside failing container
ldd /usr/local/lib/libcuda.so | grep nvidia
```
node output: driver_version=535.86, container libcuda -> 535.54 (mismatch). Looks like the image still bundles an older libcuda.

meenal: interesting — that implies the container image has libcuda from a driver-bundled runtime. we should prefer host-mounted libcuda for our runtime images. will open a quick PR to change the smoke job to mount host /usr/local/lib over the container.

sam: if PR is trivial, let's patch canary first and rerun. Otherwise fallback to forcing image pin in CI job.

infra-robin: rerun finished: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/2045/runs/2 — warmup passed on H100. final checks show container now picks up host libcuda (535.86). Looks like previous image build included stale libcuda during the last image publish.

alex: awesome, thanks. Can we mark this a provisioning drift incident and add postmortem note so we avoid bundling driver libs in runtime images?

meenal: will handle the postmortem + the tiny PR to mount host libcuda on smoke jobs. tagging it as `postmortem/provisioning-drift-3419876543`.

tara: closing loop with eng-sre — please confirm if auto-upgrade triggered the image publish or if it was human.

infra-robin: quick followup — manual image publish slipped a stale lib during a fast rebuild. I've added a CI check to fail image publishes if libcuda version inside the image != host baseline.

alex: great. thanks everyone. :tada:
